integrity: The analytical proof establishes the infinite-dimensional cutoff, Gaussian total-variation profile and chi-square profile. Exact-rational finite tests supplement but do not replace the proof. No independent validation has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Proof applies to random-scan unbiased, overlapping adjacent-edge updates on cycles; does not assert weighted-edge, interacting-spin, or diverging-window results.
The approximation is asymptotic in L2 density, not equality of finite-step laws.
Historical priority remains unverified by an independent auditor.
title: Gaussian cutoff profile for adjacent-edge heat-bath on a binary cycle
